reviews.text:
I visited your clinic because my 6-year-old degu was acting strangely.

Dr. Miyama treated my degu and diagnosed it with an odontoma.

She explained the situation and future treatment plan thoroughly, and presented treatment options, which put my mind at ease.

I was also reassured by her accurate answers to my questions.

During the surgery, she coordinated with other hospitals, and it was a great success.

Recovery after the surgery went smoothly, and after being discharged, she was so excited to be back home that she's been acting like a mischievous old lady!

I had a negative impression of animal hospitals based on past experiences, but thanks to Dr. Miyama and all the nurses, that impression was completely dispelled.

I am truly grateful.

Thank you.

I would like Dr. Miyama to continue treating my pet in the future.

Thank you very much.

My dog ​​caught a cold, so I went to this hospital. Normally, a cold medicine costing around 3,000 yen would be enough, but here they recommended things like a nebulizer and a 3-day hospital stay, trying to get me to spend around 20,000 to 50,000 yen. 😅
I think a 3,000 yen medicine is usually sufficient. Be careful.

Dr. Miyama cared for our chameleon, Kameko.
I was nervous because I had trouble finding a hospital that would treat reptiles, but the doctor always explained things to me carefully, so I felt at ease every time I went.

After Kameko laid eggs, she became ill, so he gave her the necessary treatment, including IV drips. He also gave me advice on how to care for her at home, which helped me stay calm.

Even when my child took Kameko alone, he took a video of me explaining the X-ray results so that we could watch it at home, which was very considerate and helped our whole family understand what was going on.

Unfortunately, Kameko has passed away, but we are truly grateful for the careful care he provided until the very end.

Flowers arrived the day after Kameko passed away, and our whole family was comforted by his warm thoughtfulness. He is a doctor we can trust with our precious family member. Thank you so much, Dr. Miyama.

Rabbit, Polish Lop-eared
We have been taking our 10-year-old senior rabbit to this vet since last autumn. We are fortunate to see the small animal specialist on Tuesdays and Wednesdays, which is convenient for us.
The vet is always incredibly thorough and meticulous in explaining everything—the examination, medication, physical examination, blood test results, etc. They are very knowledgeable and kind.
We have already visited 4-5 times, and I appreciate their consideration for medical expenses. The difference between this vet and the one we used before moving here is so significant that I wanted to leave this comment to express my gratitude for finding them. Thank you.

I visited for the first time to get my cat's triple vaccine (second dose). 
The doctor was very kind and explained things carefully, which gave me peace of mind. I would like to continue using your services in the future.

Previously, when I visited for grooming, I noticed a scratch near my dog's eye after arriving home. When I immediately went to inquire, I was told that they didn't believe it was caused by them. They also said they would contact me later as the groomer had already left, but I never heard from them. There were clear signs of clipper use, and since it happened immediately after grooming, I felt very uneasy.

I understand that dogs are important family members and that grooming services are provided despite busy schedules, but I was very saddened by this experience.

I sincerely hope that no other dogs will ever be injured again, and that this incident doesn't lead to a serious accident.

They were incredibly kind and helpful. I'm so grateful. My child has a bad temper, and other hospitals have used rough methods on him. The doctors and nurses here were so kind and made every effort to minimize stress on my child. Thank you so much. I feel so relieved.

Thank you for taking care of my cat's neutering! The hospital was incredibly clean, and since I had an appointment, there was absolutely no waiting time, which was very convenient!
Also, all the reception staff were very kind and easy to talk to, which made me feel great!
And I was treated by Dr. Takagi; he explained everything clearly and taught me a lot, which I really appreciated!
I'll definitely be using your services again in the future!

The doctor was very kind and excellent. However, in urgent cases, you can only get an appointment far in advance, so you're treated as an emergency patient, and the fees are quite high... It's a good hospital, but it's extremely crowded. There were quite a few patients who seemed to be from China. Perhaps that's because there was a Chinese person at the reception desk.

I visited your clinic because my hamster had an ear infection.

In the early stages, I was concerned about a red swelling below the ear (around the cheek area), so I took him to another vet.

They said they didn't know what the illness was and prescribed an antibiotic called Victus, telling me to wait and see for a week.

The symptoms worsened rapidly, so I frantically searched for a specialist hospital and found this one.

As the reviews said, the receptionist and the doctor were wonderful, and they explained the condition carefully, which put my mind at ease.

They cleaned the ear, drained the pus, took an X-ray, and prescribed medication. I'll monitor him for now, but if anything else happens in the future, I'll definitely come back to this hospital.

If you're worried about swelling or other symptoms in your hamster, please take them to a knowledgeable hospital like this one immediately!

Thank you so much!
